name: Alice Mason Saotome
original_name: アリサ・メイスン・早乙女
source:
Younger of Saotome twins. She's an innocent and energetic little girl, who's friendly to everyone. She can be seen as silly in times, but is in fact really clever and has a good sense of humor.

She absorbs any knowledge at a blink of an eye.
